Product Designer (UX/UI) · Berlin I find out what's really holding people back. Then I design the fix

I'm Tobias, six years in UX for B2C and B2B products, with a focus on design systems. Sometimes it's customers who don't trust a price, sometimes a design system that design and code no longer agree on. I build prototypes in code with AI, so ideas get tested before anyone commits to them.

Design to Code

A design system as the single source of truth

A design system for a company building safety-critical software had grown for years without tokens, and parts of it lived only in code. In three months I made Figma the single source of truth, with a workflow straight into code, ready for AI-supported development.

Prime League

An esports platform people can follow

Prime League ran several leagues on one platform, and its navigation followed the league's data model, not the people using it. As the UX designer on the team, I researched why people got lost and restructured the platform around the one question everyone had: when and where is the next match?

The common thread

Honest beats pushy.

Not the usual route into design

In restaurants I learned to notice an unhappy guest before they say anything. Science got me used to checking assumptions with data. And live commentary means explaining a chaotic game in plain words, in real time.

Today, with six years in UX, I work as a UX/UI and product designer in Berlin, freelance and open to selected roles. I design products across B2B SaaS, travel and gaming, and I build the systems that keep them consistent.
